Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary awakened.feat.Label: Craft: Awakened Feather
Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary awakened.feat.StartDescription:
Spark a life-current in an abandoned feather. 

[Anbary & Lapidary with Prentice-level <sprite name=sky> creates Awakened Feather. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: spark those energies in a Liquid, curdling it into an alchemical essence.]
Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary awakened.feat.Desc: A smooth sweep of quill alert with life.

Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary salts.bitterb.Label: Craft: Bitterblack Salts
Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary salts.bitterb.StartDescription:
Something from the boundaries of the jeweller's art: concentrate smouldering essences into a Forge ingredient. 

[Anbary & Lapidary with Prentice-level <sprite name=forge> creates Bitterblack Salts. Or for a Scholar-level recipe:  if I add Liquid, but retain Scholar-level Forge, the essences will take longer to cool, and redden into something more potent.]
Data:Craft.anbary.lapidary salts.bitterb.Desc: Bitterblack Salts have been used as an ingredient in jeweller's polish, but they have many other purposes.

Data:Craft.applebrighteuphonies confound.Label: Craft: Confounding Parable

Data:Craft.applebrighteuphonies music.be.Label: Craft: Beguiling Melody
Data:Craft.applebrighteuphonies music.be.StartDescription:
Conceive or recall a delightful little music. 

[Applebright Euphonies with Prentice-level <sprite name=grail> creates Beguiling Melody. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I hum that music to a mixture which includes a Flower, it'll give the mixture an intoxicating quality.]
Data:Craft.applebrighteuphonies music.be.Desc: I'll be humming this for a while. And so will anyone else who happens by.

Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations eigengr.Label: Craft: Eigengrau
Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations eigengr.StartDescription:
Distil a kind of possibility. 

[Auroral Contemplations with Prentice-level <sprite name=lantern> creates Eigengrau. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: mix in another Liquid to produce an alchemical essence.]
Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations eigengr.Desc: The surface of the substance is difficult to resolve - almost as if it weren't there at all.

Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations torgues.Label: Craft: Torgue's Cleansing
Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations torgues.StartDescription:
Purge myself of harmonious resonances, accruing some personal Edge. It won't be pleasant. 

[Auroral Contemplations with Prentice-level <sprite name=edge> creates Torgue's Cleansing. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: add something with a Memory aspect, and I have the makings of a significant Edge Memory.]
Data:Craft.auroralcontemplations torgues.Desc: The Cleansing has left my skin burning, my teeth throbbing. The Corrivality rumbles beneath the membraneous surfaces of the waking world.
